summary: The buyer has to check the lid as well as the deposit before ordering another case of cans.
realLife: Oregon barred easily detached pull tabs while alternatives were scarce, and can sales initially fell before other lids became common.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: separate container-design and deposit provisions.

turns.what: A buyer switches to containers with a compliant opening.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed order has detachable lids where they are prohibited.
turns.writesBack: The replacement order specifies an allowed closure.

turns.what: If the refund disappears but the lid restriction survives, the old pull-tab design stays off the order.
turns.pulledBy: Lawmakers repealed the refund provision alone.
turns.writesBack: The purchase order retains the lid requirement.
